I genuinely do lean toward empirical evidence when it comes to forming opinions about how the world works. Intuition and philosophical reasoning are valuable, but I don't think they're superior as a guide to truth. "Everyone knows" isn't evidence, and I don't actually think everyone agrees with you on this.

If you want to argue for the other approach, I'm happy to hear the case. But I'm not going to pretend I believe something I don't.
